answer: Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity bonds: each agent locks a copper-denominated deposit tied to a verifiable hardware root, and reputation grows on a trellis of attested epochs. Forging N identities costs N deposits plus N hardware proofs, while honest agents recover stake on exit. A crystal-clear audit trail of peer attestations makes fake clusters detectable, so the attack cost scales linearly with the number of sybils rather than staying flat.
